title: French Language – Level 01
overview: French Language – Level 01 is an introductory course for learners with little or no previous knowledge of French. It develops the foundations of pronunciation, essential vocabulary, basic grammar and practical communication through everyday situations. Learners gradually build confidence in understanding simple spoken French, introducing themselves, asking and answering questions, reading short texts and writing basic messages. The course uses guided practice, realistic dialogues and regular feedback to prepare participants for further French study.
audience: Beginners seeking a structured introduction to French; students and professionals preparing for travel, study or work in French-speaking environments; customer-facing employees; and anyone wishing to acquire practical everyday French communication skills. No prior French language knowledge is required.
methodology: Interactive instructor-led lessons; pronunciation and listening drills; model dialogues and paired speaking practice; vocabulary games; guided grammar exercises; short reading and writing tasks; situational role plays; digital audio activities; frequent formative checks; and a final integrated communication assessment.
competencies: Recognizing and producing common French sounds and basic spelling patterns.
Using essential greetings, introductions and courteous expressions.
Understanding and responding to familiar questions and simple instructions.
Applying basic sentence structures, articles, pronouns and present-tense verbs.
Exchanging information about personal details, family, time and everyday routines.
Reading simple notices, forms, messages and short descriptive texts.
Writing short sentences and practical messages with reasonable accuracy.
Communicating appropriately in routine social and travel situations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Pronounce the French alphabet and common sounds with improved clarity.
Introduce themselves and others and exchange basic personal information.
Ask and answer simple questions about familiar topics using everyday vocabulary.
Use common present-tense verbs and basic grammatical patterns in short sentences.
Identify numbers, dates, times, prices and simple directions in spoken and written French.
Understand the main meaning of slow, clearly articulated everyday exchanges.
Read short texts and complete simple forms in French.
Write brief messages and descriptions about routine situations.
Participate in short guided conversations with appropriate greetings and courtesy.
